SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (38/2026) ON 15/11/2026
Concerning The Renewal of circular (3/2023) Concerning “Chemical & Other Liquid Bulk” Tankers’ (Laden\ Ballast) direct voyages only
----------
Suez Canal Authority decided that circular no. (3/2023) & it’s renewing and amending periodical issued on 13 December 2023, concerning “Chemical & Other Liquid Bulk” Tankers [laden (transit dues rate 6L)\ ballast (transit dues rate 6B)] directly operating between the “American Gulf” (starting from Miami port and its western ports within the “American Gulf” also ports located southern of the “American Gulf”) on one side and India and its eastern ports on the other side, shall remain in force until 30 June 2027 (the last permissible sailing date from origin port is 30 June 2027).

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (40/2026) ON 15/11/2026
Regarding The Renewal of circular (8/2023) Concerning “Containerships” (laden/ballast) directly coming from ports at “North-West Europe” and directly heading to (Port Klang) port and its Eastern ports at the “Far East” (only for direct voyages)
---------------
Suez Canal Authority has decided that circular no. 8/2023 issued on 17 October 2023, concerning the exemption granted to “Containerships” (laden/ballast) directly coming from ports at “North-West Europe” (and Tangier port) starting from Algeciras port and directly heading to (Port Klang) and its Eastern ports at “South-East of Asia” and the “Far East” from the 15% increase in the normal transit dues stipulated in para (a), article one of circular (7/2023.), shall remain in force till 30 June 2027 (the last permissible sailing date from origin port is 30 June 2027).

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (41/2026) ON 15/11/2026
Regarding The Renewal of circular (10/2023) Concerning (Laden/Ballast) “Vehicles Carriers” (only for direct voyages)
--------------
Suez Canal Authority has decided that circular no. 10/2023 issued on 13 December 2023, concerning (Laden/Ballast) “Vehicles Carriers” operating directly between ports at the “East Coast of the Americas and the US Gulf” and ports at the “Far East and South East of Asia (starting from Port Klang and its Eastern ports)”, shall remain in force till 30 June 2027 (the last permissible sailing date from origin port is 30 June 2027).

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (37/2026) ON 15/11/2026
Regarding The Renewal of circular (2/2023) Concerning Laden “Petroleum Products” Tankers’ direct voyages only
------------
Suez Canal Authority has decided that circular no. 2/2023 & its renewing and amending periodical issued on 13 December 2023, ​​ concerning “Petroleum Products” tankers (transit dues rate 2L), directly operating between ports of the (US Gulf, Caribbean area & Latin America) and Asian ports, shall remain in force till the 30 June 2027 (the last permissible sailing date from origin port is 30 June 2027).

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (36/2026) ON 15/11/2026
Regarding The Renewal of circular (4/2020) Concerning Liquified Petroleum Gas (LPG) Carriers’ direct voyages only
----------
Suez Canal Authority decided that circular no. (4/2020) & it’s renewing and amending periodical issued on 18 December 2022, concerning Liquefied Petroleum Gas‏ ‏‎(LPG) carriers ‎(Laden or Ballast) directly operating between (the East Coast of the Americas & the “US Gulf”) and‎ (India & its Eastern ports), shall remain in force until 30 June 2027 (the last permissible sailing date from origin port is 30 June 2027).

SUEZ CANAL AUTHORITY PERIODICAL NO. (39/2026) ON 15/11/2026
Regarding The Renewal of circular (2/2016) Concerning laden or ballast “Containerships” coming from ports at the “East Coast of the Americas and the US Gulf” and heading to ports “at the South and South East of Asia” (only for direct voyages)
------------
Suez Canal Authority decided that circular no. (2/2016), its amendment issued on 13 July 2016 and its amending periodical issued on 27 September 2020 and its amending and renewal periodical issued on 13 December 2023 (which grants rebates to laden or ballast “Containerships” directly coming from ports at the East Coast of the Americas & the US Gulf and directly heading to ports ‎at the South and South East of Asia) shall remain inforce until 30 June 2027 (the last permissible sailing date from “port of origin” is 30 June 2027).
